Summary: {name} is polylactic acid. Makers sell it for prototypes and display models, and a printer maker's guide rates it easy to print. It is amorphous as printed, so it softens at its glass transition: its {hdt045.label} is {hdt045.median}, and the heavier load gives the same. On the H2C it needs no heated chamber and, except a few filled products, no hardened nozzle. Makers' statements on acids and alkalis mostly say it does not resist them.

Summary: {name} is a glass-fibre-filled PCTG copolyester. A maker sells it for tooling, equipment and manufacturing aids, and its makers stress its low shrinkage. Its {hdt045.label} is {hdt045.range}, below its glass transition. On the H2C it prints at {nozzle.window} without chamber heat, but makers call for a ruby or hardened steel nozzle and for drying before printing.
